text: Entitlements to order, stock and contract data reviewed and kept current
Authenticate every request to the order portal, stock views and contract data against the corporate identity provider
Evaluate the access policy for each request using role, device, location and request context before returning order, stock or contract data
Require step-up multi-factor authentication for privileged actions (amending a confirmed order, changing contract prices, releasing quarantined stock, changing entitlements)
Verify the identity of the hospital buyer before any order, stock or contract data is released through the portal
Propagate the end-user identity to the LLM ordering assistant so that every assistant-initiated request is authorized under that user's entitlements
Log every access decision (identity, request, decision, timestamp) for order, stock and contract data
Run a quarterly review of roles and entitlements with the data owners and revoke unused or excessive access
Record the outcome and approval of each access review in the access review register
Identity provider with multi-factor authentication
Policy decision point for order, stock and contract data
Access decision and change log
Access review register
Ordering assistant gateway that enforces authentication and policy checks on LLM requests
IT Security Officer
Data Protection Officer
Sales Administrator
Hospital Buyer
Responsible Pharmacist
Quality Assurance Officer
AI Product Owner
No network location, including the office network, is trusted by default
Regulation requires a traceable record of who accessed or changed order, stock and contract data
The LLM ordering assistant holds no entitlements of its own and always acts on behalf of an authenticated user
Shared accounts are not permitted; every human and every service must use a named identity
Identity is verified before any order, stock or contract data is released
Policy decisions may be cached for at most 5 minutes for non-privileged read requests; privileged actions are always re-verified
Only the Responsible Pharmacist may release quarantined medicines, and only after multi-factor authentication
A confirmed order cannot be edited without an authenticated change request by an entitled user
